title: IVG Intense Salts Blue 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: IVG Intense Salts Blue centres on the bold taste of ripe Blueberries, blending sweet and slightly tart notes for a rounded berry experience. It delivers a flavour that’s juicy, full-bodied, and satisfying from the first puff. With a 50VG/50PG ratio, Blue offers clear flavour and a tactile yet comfortable throat hit. Available in 10mg and 20mg Nic Salt strengths, it’s best enjoyed in mouth-to-lung (MTL) devices such as pod kits, vape pens and starter systems. Part of the IVG Intense Salts range, this e-liquid showcases IVG’s expertise in creating flavours that are both vibrant and consistent, making Blue a solid choice for those who enjoy berry-inspired profiles.
